faq_heading: Questions developers ask about sales dashboards

faqs.q: How much does a real estate sales dashboard cost?
faqs.a: Cost depends on the number of data sources, projects and measures you want. Clara AI sets the scope after a diagnosis and then shares a clear proposal.

faqs.q: How long does it take to go live?
faqs.a: Go-live depends on the number of sources, the quality of the data and how quickly your team agrees the measures and rules. Clara AI confirms a timeline after diagnosis, based on your actual material.

faqs.q: Which systems can it connect to?
faqs.a: Typically your CRM, ad accounts, call logs and the lead feeds from your property portals. The exact list is confirmed during diagnosis.

faqs.q: Do we need to replace our CRM?
faqs.a: No. The dashboard reads from your CRM and other sources. It adds a combined view and does not replace the system your team uses.
